_comment: RATCHET. This file is the list of import cycles Corvus still carries, and it
may only get SHORTER. The fitness test in backend/tests/test_architecture_cycles.py
asserts this list matches the cycles in architecture/architecture.json exactly,
- a cycle in the code that is NOT here fails the gate (no new cycles);
- an entry here that is NO LONGER a cycle also fails (fix it, then delete the
entry — stale entries would let the ratchet slip back up unnoticed).
Raising `budget` is the only way to admit a new cycle, and it is deliberately a
one-line diff in a file named for the debt it tracks, so review cannot miss it.

history.note: Baseline at record 04 seam 1: compliance registry/frameworks/providers (20), governance policies (4), maintenance/reconsolidation cluster (12), executor/pipeline stages (8), neuron_index<->neuron_service (2).

Record 04a retired the compliance context; its 20-module cycle left with it. Not a decoupling win — registry.py imported inside load_all(), so the extractor was counting a plugin registry it could not see through.

Record 04 seam 2: broke neuron_index <-> neuron_service by extracting NeuronCandidate and FRESHNESS_SQL into app/services/neuron_candidate.py, a leaf module with no imports. neuron_index sits UNDER the service and was importing it back for two pieces of shared vocabulary; executor was reaching through the service's privacy for the same SQL. First cycle broken by decoupling rather than by deletion.

Record 04 seam 3: broke the app.governance.policies package-init cycle by extracting PolicyContext, ViolationDraft and the config helpers into policies/base.py. The __init__ defined the base types AND imported the three concrete policies to build POLICY_CLASSES, while each policy imported those types back; the `# noqa: E402` on the bottom imports was the confession. __init__ is now a pure facade, so every external importer is unchanged.

Record 04 seam 4: broke executor <-> pipeline.stages <-> structural_resolver. Two loops were braided into one 8-module cycle. executor was doing two jobs — holding the recall algorithms AND building/running the pipeline that calls them — so the thin stage wrappers imported it back; separately structural_resolver constructs PreparedContext, which also lived in executor. Extracted recall_primitives.py (9 functions, 427 lines) and prepared_context.py. executor 2087 -> 1633 lines and now imports both one-way.

Record 04b: the 12-module maintenance/reconsolidation cluster — the last measured cycle and the only one carrying evidence-gated writes. A read-only mapping pass classified all twelve as write-path, propose-path or pure computation BEFORE any file moved, and it falsified the plan the record proposed: reconsolidation.plan is indeed shared vocabulary, but it was ALREADY a near-leaf whose five module-scope importers all point downward, so extracting it would have moved nothing. Its single outbound edge — snapshot_of reaching up for mind_lint.content_hash — was the whole of its participation. Three cuts, all of them vocabulary in the wrong layer: (1) extracted mind_corpus.py, the maintenance substrate mind_janitors held underneath its own schedule — EVERY back-edge in the cycle wanted only primitives (LESSON_TYPES, _log_action, _load_lessons, _similar_pairs, EPISODE_DIR, BORDERLINE_SIM, _add_memory_edge) and none wanted a janitor pass; eight modules outside the cycle were reaching in for the same names. content_hash moved down with them, which is what freed plan. (2) CHARTER_TIERS moved to delivery_mode: charter MEMBERSHIP belongs with the membership gate, skill_compiler owns RENDERING. (3) The FusionPlan wire format was split across two modules — serializer in lifecycle, deserializer in apply, each importing the other back — and both moved to plan.py beside the two hashes they verify. No gate was weakened: the direct ORM writes to protected columns stayed in mind_janitors, graph_writers.json is unchanged, and the reference-class identity-wall guard was RE-AIMED at the substrate's new home with its aggregate bar held at two rather than lowered. mind_janitors 1145 -> 1057 lines. Hypothesis 3 (apply <-> lifecycle is genuinely behavioural) was also falsified: it was the wire format, not behaviour. Zero cycles across all 367 modules.
